body:
Please merge origin/wp/B5-test-isolation (bab90835, on 5cdd122a) before B5-19. Both commits are small and tooling/test only.

1. 16eb1ac8, test only. DevelopRecoveryAdmissionBehaviorTests.testSupersededFolderCallbackSettlesOnceAndMayReenterOpenFolder called AppModel.openFolder against the REAL catalog, ~/Library/Application Support/Tessera/index.sqlite, because the test process doesn't set TESSERA_APP_DIR. It flaked whenever another test run or the app held that catalog's write lock (BEGIN IMMEDIATE plus the 5 s busy timeout beat the test's 8 s wait). Reproduced by holding a lock from sqlite3. The fix scopes TESSERA_APP_DIR to the fixture for the test's duration.
   Results: 5/5 alone; the class 19/19; swift-gate OK on main (703 tests) and with B5-19 applied (713 tests).
   Side effect for you to know: the real catalog has about 30 leftover roots pointing at deleted temp destination-c folders. They're untouched, since that's user data. Other tests may deserve the same audit.
2. bab90835, build. build-ffi.sh and make-app.sh defaulted every worktree to one shared ~/.cache/tessera-target/mac-ffi. Concurrent gates could copy another worktree's libtessera_ffi.a and generate bindings from the wrong source; it actually happened once with B5-19. The default is now mac-ffi-<checkout dir name>, and an explicit CARGO_TARGET_DIR still wins. README is updated. With both machines running parallel builds this matters.
